n: 30 In. Gas Cooktop With 4 Gas Burners
desc: Luxury isn’t meant to be left desired—it’s meant to be attainable. The ZLINE 30 in. Gas Cooktop with 4 Gas Burners (RC30) provides a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.

Perfectly accommodate any style with a versatile drop-in installation process that adapts to custom kitchen countertops or island designs
Featuring a high-grade 304 stainless steel finish paired with durable cast iron grates for easy transfer of pots and pans
4 ergonomic control knobs are conveniently located on top of the stainless steel surface, making it easy to control multiple burners at once
A heavy-duty, hand-finished stainless steel one-piece cooktop allows for easy cleaning and maintenance
